integrity.computational_scope: Finite exact-rational checks corroborate, but do not prove, the unrestricted theorem.
integrity.methods: An analytical all-integer derivation, including exact edge-category integrations and a vertex comparison, independently checked at n=3,...,18 by exact rational geometric integration.

scientific_limitations: Unit-length edges, intrinsic metric, independent uniform total-arclength sampling, n>=3; formulas concern first moments only.
The untwisted prism formula is contextual, and the new assertion is the exact Moebius-ladder formula and positive parity-sensitive twist gap.
Historical priority is uncertain, particularly because the 1982 Doyle-Graver paper was accessible only as an abstract.
